steps.name: Set up job
Initialize containers
Explicit native toolchains and measurement tools
Run actions/checkout@v7
Run dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
Run actions/cache@v6
Verify source and both timing readers
Build ordinary production compilers at both exact revisions
Count proof traversals separately and require unchanged emitted C
Verify real timing callers and wrong-result, release and clock controls
Contemporary C, Rust and Swift peers in two balanced sessions
Verify peer evidence and reject altered observations
Ordinary reference versus candidate using the same audited C pilots
Reconstruct all reference and candidate observations
Ordinary compiler costs and diagnostic agreement
Retain all observations, including incomplete or failed cases
Post Run actions/cache@v6
Post Run actions/checkout@v7
Stop containers
Complete job
